# JAMX real recording regression

Source: [SatNOGS observation 14907288](https://network.satnogs.org/observations/14907288/),
JF6FYI (station 5049), 2026-08-30 02:41:34 UTC, 435.5 MHz BPSK 9600.
[Observer's image report](https://community.libre.space/t/cz-6c-launches-jamx01-by70-4-2026-08-25-03-30utc/15173/227).

The original OGG is 48 kHz mono, 553.087 seconds. Convert with
`sndfile-convert -float32 input.ogg input.wav`, then run
`ASRTU1_Benchmark input.wav result.json --real-if`.
The benchmark writes deduplicated complete frames to `result.json.frames223.bin`.

The 1.5.5 Windows run decoded 329 complete frames: 232 VC2 telemetry frames
and 97 VC1 frames with JAMX SSDV CRC (initial value `0x6AAAC1C5`).
`jamx_satnogs_14907288.b64` contains those 97 unmodified 223-byte image frames,
in reception order. They reconstruct image 0 (640 x 480), with 56 distinct
218-byte packets, showing the reported kaleidoscope. No user station data or
credentials are included. The full audio and generated outputs remain in the
ignored local `work/` directory. Source observation attribution is retained here.
